summary.text: Deanna Self is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 64, who assumed office on January 8, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Self is a retired licensed professional counselor.

paragraphs.text: Deanna Self was born in Wood River, Illinois.
She earned an associate degree from St. Louis Community College-Meramec in 1986 and two graduate degrees from Covenant Theological Seminary in 2001 and 2007.
Her career experience includes working as a licensed professional counselor for individual, couple, marriage and family therapy.
Self has served in various ministry leadership roles and as North County chapter chair and St. Charles County chapter chair for Missouri Right to Life.
In the Missouri House, Self was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee for 2025-2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, mom, grandma and retired professional counselor.
She listed her campaign priorities as cutting taxes, protecting the 2nd Amendment, protecting unborn babies, protecting parental rights, protecting girls' sports and protecting conservative values.
